value.rationale: This is a motivated finite extremal problem: sharp failure of static-kernel pointwise domination under a time-invariant stationary distribution, with smallest possible order, explicit graph mechanism and full n=4 supremum. It refines asymptotic guarantees by an exact finite structural boundary; the effect size is only 6.43%, and there is no unproved general-order conclusion.
